title: Musical family: sister, uncle, grandfather
summary: Nobody in the family was seriously musical; his sister played piano and he thumped out harmony by ear.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You are going to ask me the questions. Well, again, as I said, beginning at the beginning, was anyone in your family musical?

Well, let's see. Not particularly. My sister played the piano but I was interested in music -- I had a good ear, as far as I was concerned, I could tell it early, and I used to thump out on the piano, you know, without lessons. Harmony and things like that.

My uncle used to do the same thing. My grandfather told me one time that he was a tuba player. They came from England, Wales and we were all musically inclined. We liked music, but there's no one who was particular about seeing that I got to New England Conservatory.
